title: Enhancing the Outcome Reward-based RL Training of MLLMs with Self-Consistency Sampling
authors_zh: Jiahao Wang；Weiye Xu；Aijun Yang；Wengang Zhou；Lewei Lu；Houqiang Li；Xiaohua Wang；Jinguo Zhu
paper_type_zh: Rollout、搜索或测试时推理轨迹研究
best_for_zh: 需要审计测试时 rollout、选择器、反馈信号和计算预算的读者
one_line: A multimodal online-RL rollout/resampling recipe with official code and data links.
SCS 对视觉推理轨迹作小视觉扰动、截断和重采样，以轨迹一致性分数降低“猜对但推理错误”的结果奖励影响。
why: It is valuable because it exposes where multimodal trace construction needs stronger provenance: perturbations, resampling seeds, outcome/format rewards, and dataset-count reconciliation.
inclusion_reason: It is valuable because it exposes where multimodal trace construction needs stronger provenance: perturbations, resampling seeds, outcome/format rewards, and dataset-count reconciliation.

title: Problem
问题
html:
Outcome-reward RL for multimodal large language models can verify a multiple-choice answer cheaply, but a correct option does not establish that the visual perception or reasoning trajectory was correct. A trajectory that misreads an image and then guesses the right option receives the same terminal accuracy reward as a faithful solution. Dense process supervision could distinguish them, but it requires a process verifier or additional annotation.

Self-Consistency Sampling (SCS) treats this as an online rollout-construction and feedback problem. For each image-question prompt, the relevant data object includes the initial reasoning trajectory, a truncated prefix, stochastic image perturbations, resampled continuations and option answers, the set of distinct answers, accuracy reward, format reward, consistency reward, and the policy update that consumes them. The decision boundary is multimodal multiple-choice RLVR rather than general proof verification: answer agreement is a proxy for stability, not direct validation of every reasoning step.

The paper describes a filtered training mixture from M3CoT, Geometry3K, and ScienceQA. The official Hugging Face release provides prompt-answer JSONL files and an image archive, while the code repository implements training and evaluation. Those artifacts do not establish a complete release of initial trajectories, truncation points, perturbation seeds, all continuations, or per-rollout rewards, so SCS should not be represented as a fully replayable trace corpus.

面向 multimodal large language models 的 outcome-reward RL 可以低成本核验多项选择题答案，但选项正确并不能证明视觉感知或推理轨迹正确。若轨迹误读图像后碰巧猜中选项，它得到的终局准确率奖励与忠实解答相同。Dense process supervision 可以区分二者，但需要 process verifier 或额外标注。

Self-Consistency Sampling（SCS）将其处理为在线 rollout 构造与反馈问题。对每个图像—问题 prompt，关键数据对象包括初始 reasoning trajectory、截断前缀、随机图像扰动、重采样 continuation 与选项答案、不同答案集合、accuracy reward、format reward、consistency reward，以及使用这些信号的 policy update。其决策边界是 multimodal multiple-choice RLVR，而非通用证明验证：答案一致只是稳定性代理，不能直接验证每个推理步骤。

论文描述了由 M3CoT、Geometry3K、ScienceQA 过滤得到的训练混合。官方 Hugging Face release 提供 prompt-answer JSONL 和图像归档，代码仓库实现训练与评测；但这些 artifact 未证明初始轨迹、截断点、扰动 seed、全部 continuation 和逐 rollout 奖励已完整发布，因此不能把 SCS 表述为可完全重放的 trace corpus。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
SCS augments terminal outcome reward with a consistency signal computed from controlled continuations of the same partial trajectory. It first samples an initial rationale, keeps a prefix according to truncation ratio k, and resamples the suffix m times. Each continuation sees a slightly perturbed version of the image, with Gaussian noise strength drawn independently from a bounded range. The option answers from the continuations form a set A; the paper's normalized formulation assigns consistency reward c times (N minus the number of distinct answers) divided by N. Fewer distinct options therefore produce a larger reward.

The full feedback contract mixes three signals: answer accuracy from the known option, output-format compliance, and answer consistency after truncation and perturbation. The consistency term is differentiable through the policy-gradient objective as a scalar trajectory reward, but it remains a heuristic: a shared wrong continuation can be consistent, and several valid rationales can be diverse. SCS is inserted into RLOO, GRPO, REINFORCE++-baseline, and REINFORCE++ rather than defining a new optimizer.

Compared with plain outcome-reward RL, SCS inspects counterfactual continuations before rewarding the initial trajectory. Compared with a process reward model, it does not learn dense step labels from a separate model. Its track relevance comes from the resampling record itself: truncation, perturbation, option diversity, and component rewards must be retained to attribute any gain to data/feedback construction rather than only to the optimizer.

SCS 用同一局部轨迹的受控 continuation 构造一致性信号，并把它加入终局 outcome reward。系统先采样初始 rationale，按截断比例 k 保留前缀，再对后缀重采样 m 次；每个 continuation 使用轻微扰动后的图像，高斯噪声强度从有界区间独立采样。各 continuation 的选项答案形成集合 A；论文的归一化公式令 consistency reward 等于 c 乘以“N 减去不同答案数”再除以 N，因此不同选项越少，奖励越高。

完整反馈契约混合三类信号：已知选项带来的 answer accuracy、输出格式合规，以及截断和扰动后的 answer consistency。一致性项作为标量 trajectory reward 进入 policy-gradient objective，但它仍是启发式信号：共同错误的 continuation 也可能一致，多条有效 rationale 也可能多样。SCS 被嵌入 RLOO、GRPO、REINFORCE++-baseline 和 REINFORCE++，并未定义新的 optimizer。

相对普通 outcome-reward RL，SCS 在奖励初始轨迹前检查其反事实 continuation；相对 process reward model，它不依赖另一模型学习 dense step labels。其 track 价值来自 resampling record 本身：必须保留截断、扰动、选项多样性和各奖励分量，才能把增益归因于 data/feedback construction，而不是只归因于 optimizer。

title: Method
方法
html:
Training prompts are filtered to multiple-choice examples with associated images. Table 1 reports 7.8k M3CoT, 2.1k Geometry3K, and 6.2k retained ScienceQA items, approximately 16.1k examples in total. The official Qwen-format JSONL inspected in the Hugging Face release contains 16,180 rows, so the paper's rounded table and released file should be reconciled rather than treated as identical counts. Each released row stores a question, answer, and serialized multimodal message; it is prompt data, not a rollout/reward ledger.

During RL, the current policy samples an initial trajectory. SCS truncates it, perturbs the image independently for each continuation, resamples option answers, computes consistency from answer-set size, and adds accuracy and format rewards. For the Qwen2.5-VL-7B RLOO configuration, the appendix reports batch size 128, temperature 1, 16 samples per prompt, maximum generation length 3000, truncation ratio 0.8, and four resampled trajectories. GRPO uses ratio 0.4 and eight resamples; the two REINFORCE++ variants use ratio 0.8 with four or eight resamples. The paper evaluates Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct, and InternVL3-8B with a structured reasoning-and-answer output format.

The environment is OpenRLHF-based online multimodal RL. The terminal verifier checks option correctness and output format; SCS supplies an additional scalar from resampled answer agreement, not a step-level judge. The paper reports eight A800 GPUs and roughly 24 hours for experiments, while an appendix timing table describes an eight-A100 comparison of 12.5 hours versus 17.2 hours; hardware and run-scope differences need reconciliation. Official Apache-2.0 code, training scripts, evaluation code, and HF data are available, but exact image archive contents, data revisions, perturbation seeds, sampled rollouts, component rewards, checkpoints, and per-run manifests are not established as a complete replay package.

训练 prompt 被过滤为带关联图像的多项选择题。表 1 报告 M3CoT 7.8k、Geometry3K 2.1k、保留的 ScienceQA 6.2k，总计约 16.1k。经核对，Hugging Face release 中 Qwen 格式 JSONL 含 16,180 行，因此论文舍入后的表格数与发布文件应单独核对，不能直接视为完全相同。每行发布数据保存 question、answer 和序列化 multimodal message；它属于 prompt data，不是 rollout/reward ledger。

RL 期间，当前 policy 先采样初始轨迹。SCS 将其截断，对每个 continuation 独立扰动图像，重采样选项答案，根据答案集合大小计算 consistency，再加入 accuracy 与 format rewards。对 Qwen2.5-VL-7B 的 RLOO 配置，附录报告 batch size 128、temperature 1、每个 prompt 16 个样本、最大生成长度 3000、截断比例 0.8、四条重采样轨迹；GRPO 使用比例 0.4 和八次重采样；两个 REINFORCE++ 变体使用比例 0.8，并分别重采样四次或八次。论文评估 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct、Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct、InternVL3-8B，并采用结构化 reasoning-and-answer 输出格式。

环境是基于 OpenRLHF 的在线 multimodal RL。终局 verifier 检查选项正确与输出格式；SCS 额外提供来自重采样答案一致性的标量，而非 step-level judge。正文称实验使用 8 张 A800、约 24 小时，附录时长表则描述 8 张 A100 上 12.5 小时与 17.2 小时的比较，硬件和 run scope 需要协调解释。官方 Apache-2.0 代码、训练脚本、评测代码与 HF data 已发布，但图像归档具体内容、数据 revision、扰动 seed、采样 rollout、奖励分量、checkpoint 和逐 run manifest 未被证明构成完整 replay package。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Across the six reported evaluation benchmarks, adding SCS improves the corresponding RL baselines in Table 2. The largest reported average change is RLOO on Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct, from 57.8 to 65.5, or 7.7 percentage points; smaller gains are reported for GRPO, the REINFORCE++ variants, Qwen2.5-VL-3B, and InternVL3-8B. Component ablations attribute gains to both truncation-resampling and visual perturbation. Three-run intervals are reported, although the table contains an apparent mean/row inconsistency for one REINFORCE++-baseline entry that should be checked against code or logs.

The paper also manually judges 100 correctly answered cases per benchmark and asks o3-mini and Gemini 2.5 Flash to assess the same traces against public solutions. It reports fewer unfaithful rationales after SCS, with aggregate reductions around 13.6-15.2% depending on judge. This is direct evidence about a sampled evaluation set, but it is not a released dense process annotation standard and is conditioned on answers already being correct.

The official NeurIPS page, paper, code repository, and HF dataset support the existence of the method and artifacts. The HF Qwen file has 16,180 prompt rows, but no verified per-rollout reward logs were found. Accuracy gains and judged examples evaluate training behavior; they do not prove that released prompt data, image assets, or latent rollout records are complete, decontaminated, or uniformly correct.

在六个评测 benchmark 上，表 2 显示把 SCS 加入相应 RL baseline 后均有提升。最大平均变化出现在 Qwen2.5-VL-7B-Instruct 的 RLOO：从 57.8 提高到 65.5，即 7.7 个百分点；GRPO、两个 REINFORCE++ 变体、Qwen2.5-VL-3B 与 InternVL3-8B 的提升较小。组件消融把收益分别归因于 truncation-resampling 与 visual perturbation。论文还报告三次重复的区间，但其中一个 REINFORCE++-baseline 条目的均值与逐 run 数字似乎不一致，需要对照代码或日志核查。

论文还对每个 benchmark 随机抽取 100 个“答案正确”的案例进行人工判断，并让 o3-mini 与 Gemini 2.5 Flash 根据公开解答评估同一批 trace。结果称 SCS 后不忠实 rationale 更少，不同 judge 下总体下降约 13.6%–15.2%。这是对抽样评测集的直接证据，但它并非已发布的 dense process annotation 标准，而且样本以最终答案已正确为前提。

NeurIPS 官方页面、论文、代码仓库与 HF dataset 共同证明方法和 artifact 存在。HF 的 Qwen 文件含 16,180 条 prompt，但未发现已核验的逐 rollout reward log。准确率增益和人工/模型判断案例用于评估训练行为，不能证明已发布 prompt data、图像资产或潜在 rollout record 完整、去污染或普遍正确。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
Plain outcome-reward RL assigns one terminal correctness signal and cannot distinguish a faithful solution from a lucky guess. Process reward models move feedback inside the trajectory but require a learned verifier and process labels. SCS occupies an intermediate point: it creates counterfactual continuations from a partial multimodal trajectory and uses answer diversity under truncation and visual perturbation as an online scalar reward.

The individual ingredients are not new: self-consistency, image augmentation, rejection/resampling, option correctness, RLOO, GRPO, and REINFORCE++ all predate the paper. The specific change is to turn stability across perturbed suffix rollouts into a training-time feedback contract for multimodal multiple-choice reasoning, while keeping the terminal outcome reward.

For this track, the direction signal is that online RL data may include a family of related trajectories rather than one response. The quality signal comes from controlled ablations and a small faithfulness audit, but benchmark gains do not validate the released prompt corpus. Reuse should separately verify prompt provenance, perturbation policy, truncation position, continuation diversity, component rewards, and optimizer configuration.

普通 outcome-reward RL 只给一个终局正确性信号，无法区分忠实解答与碰巧猜中。Process reward model 把反馈移入轨迹内部，但需要学习式 verifier 与过程标签。SCS 位于两者之间：它从局部 multimodal trajectory 构造反事实 continuation，并把截断与视觉扰动下的答案多样性用作在线标量奖励。

各个组成部分并非首次提出：self-consistency、图像增强、rejection/resampling、选项正确性、RLOO、GRPO 和 REINFORCE++ 都早于本文。具体变化是把扰动后缀 rollout 的稳定性转化为 multimodal multiple-choice reasoning 的训练时反馈契约，同时保留终局 outcome reward。

对本 track 而言，方向信号是 online RL data 可能由一组相关轨迹构成，而不是单条 response。受控消融与小规模 faithfulness audit 提供一定质量信号，但 benchmark 增益不能验证已发布 prompt corpus。复用时应分别核验 prompt provenance、扰动策略、截断位置、continuation 多样性、奖励分量与 optimizer 配置。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
SCS assumes that a correct reasoning trajectory should lead consistently to one correct option and models the reasoning tree as having a unique correct trajectory. Real questions can admit multiple valid rationales, and consistent continuations can share the same misconception. The reward may therefore penalize legitimate diversity or reinforce correlated errors. Visual Gaussian perturbation can also change task-relevant evidence rather than only test robustness.

The demonstrated scope is image-based multiple-choice reasoning with three MLLM families; the paper itself notes that generality to LLMs and more MLLMs is not established. SCS adds resampling compute: the appendix reports 17.2 hours versus 12.5 hours in one comparison, about 38% more. Exact source manifests, splits, decontamination, image licenses, perturbation seeds, rollout/reward logs, checkpoint-selection effects, and hardware/run-scope reconciliation remain incomplete. The released prompt files do not permit independent replay of every reward assignment.

SCS 假设正确推理轨迹应稳定导向唯一正确选项，并把 reasoning tree 建模为只有一条正确轨迹。真实问题可能存在多条有效 rationale，而一致的 continuation 也可能共享同一误解。因此，该奖励可能惩罚合理多样性，或强化相关错误。高斯视觉扰动也可能改变任务关键信息，而不只是测试鲁棒性。

论文验证范围是基于图像的多项选择推理和三个 MLLM 系列；作者也明确指出，对 LLM 及更多 MLLM 的泛化尚未建立。SCS 会增加重采样计算，附录某项比较为 17.2 小时对 12.5 小时，约增加 38%。精确 source manifest、split、去污染、图像许可证、扰动 seed、rollout/reward log、checkpoint 选择效应，以及硬件/run-scope 的协调解释仍不完整。现有 prompt 文件无法独立重放每次奖励分配。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data, SCS provides a concrete schema for multimodal counterfactual rollouts used during RL. A reusable item should link the original image and question to the initial trajectory, retained prefix length, every perturbed image or noise seed, continuation, extracted option, distinct-answer count, normalized consistency reward, accuracy and format rewards, optimizer group, model checkpoint, and final update.

Keeping these fields separate supports audits of whether gains come from more samples, image augmentation, the consistency formula, terminal verification, or the RL algorithm. It also prevents the final benchmark score from being copied backward as a label for intermediate reasoning. The official prompt release can seed reproduction, but the missing rollout and reward ledger limits direct reuse for verifier training or process supervision.

在 Rollout, Search, and Test-Time Trace Data 中，SCS 提供了一个 RL 期间使用 multimodal counterfactual rollout 的具体 schema。可复用条目应把原始图像和问题连接到初始轨迹、保留前缀长度、每次扰动后的图像或 noise seed、continuation、抽取选项、不同答案数、归一化 consistency reward、accuracy/format rewards、optimizer group、model checkpoint 与最终 update。

把这些字段分开保存，才能审计增益来自更多样本、图像增强、一致性公式、终局验证还是 RL algorithm，也可避免把最终 benchmark score 反向复制成中间推理标签。官方 prompt release 可作为复现起点，但缺少 rollout 与 reward ledger，限制了它直接用于 verifier training 或 process supervision。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• SCS rewards option agreement across resampled suffixes of one truncated multimodal trajectory.
  • The feedback combines accuracy, format, and consistency; agreement is a stability proxy, not step verification.
  • The paper reports about 16.1k filtered training prompts, while the inspected Qwen release contains 16,180 JSONL rows.
  • RLOO uses 16 policy samples plus four SCS continuations at truncation ratio 0.8 in the reported 7B setup.
  • Official prompt data and code exist, but complete perturbation, rollout, and per-reward logs were not verified as released.
  • Benchmark gains and the sampled faithfulness audit do not prove prompt-data or trace-record quality.

• SCS 对同一截断 multimodal trajectory 的重采样后缀按选项一致性给奖励。
  • 反馈混合 accuracy、format 与 consistency；一致性是稳定性代理，不是 step verification。
  • 论文报告约 16.1k 个过滤训练 prompt，经核对的 Qwen release 含 16,180 行 JSONL。
  • 报告的 7B RLOO 设置使用 16 个 policy sample，并在截断比例 0.8 下生成四个 SCS continuation。
  • 官方 prompt data 与代码已发布，但完整扰动、rollout 和逐奖励日志未确认为发布。
  • Benchmark 增益和抽样 faithfulness audit 不能证明 prompt data 或 trace record 的质量。
